posts.text: Beware that there are a ton of bots pretending to be climate activists right now. They are spreading climate doom and attempting to discredit the scientists who refute it. Things are only hopeless if we all give up, and that's exactly what these bots are trying to get us to do. So keep on fighting!

posts.text: What a powerful piece that proves just how big of an issue funding is in climate spaces. I’m grateful to have built up enough paid subscribers on Good Climate News to cover my mortgage, but neither of us should have to do this on a volunteer basis! Organizations should absolutely pay up!

posts.text: I completely understand wanting to expand the audience of these organizations, but I don’t understand not wanting to pay climate creators to do work — especially considering I keep getting told how critical that work is by the very same organizations that refuse to pay me.
